name: incudo
description: A modern, system-agnostic tabletop character builder for desktop and mobile. A free and open replacement for Aurora Builder.
_workspaces_note: apps/* are deliberately NOT workspaces yet. Their package.json files declare Expo/Tauri deps for shells that do not exist, and including them makes a fresh `npm install` pull ~700MB before there is anything to run. Add "apps/*" here when Phase 1 scaffolds the desktop shell.

scripts.mobile: echo "Not scaffolded yet — see apps/mobile/README.md (ROADMAP Phase 4)." && exit 1
